mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized hepatically and may compete for metabolism; triamcinolone can enhance immunosuppressive effects of medroxyprogesterone, and corticosteroids may reduce contraceptive efficacy at higher doses.
action: Monitor for reduced contraceptive efficacy if medroxyprogesterone is used for contraception; consider backup contraception during concurrent high-dose triamcinolone use; counsel patient on increased infection risk.
